eps.d: Jersey detective Jim Bergerac returns from a recuperation leave to find his job in jeopardy and a colleague killed during an investigation into international gun sales to South Africa.
The head of a famine charity is found dead in his hotel suite, but an autopsy confirms he didn't die in bed.
A pickpocket becomes embroiled in a drug-dealing plot when he unwittingly steals cocaine from a mule on his way to Jersey.
A string of accidents implies that someone wants to prevent a Korean War veteran from publishing his memoirs.
A civil servant exposed as a spy tries to flee to Moscow, but her Russian contact is out to kill her.
A young curate is found unconscious in a church and a group of students are suspected.
Jim is on the trail of an ex-golf Pro following a spate of robberies.
Bergerac investigates the death of a skin-diver, who is found with a Luftwaffe pilot's body.
Jim tries to discover who murdered Henry Bernard, the meanest millionaire on the island.
A gangster's girlfriend is the only clue to his whereabouts.
Mrs Honeyman is an ardent reader of thriller novels, but real-life crime can often spring more surprises than a paperback plot.
A malicious crank has something to tell Summer show celebrity Andy Galbraith.
Charlie Hungerford's foray into Politics poses problems, including murder.
A French murder mystery turns into a case for Bergerac.
The Bureau is put under pressure to find the mugger of a holidaymaker, but Vincent Parkin doesn't help.
Bergerac investigates whether the death of a stuntman during the filming of a TV commercial was an accident.
A penniless Indian arrives on Jersey, claiming to be a faith healer. Soon Jim has to stop an attempt on the young man's life.
Bergerac is not convinced when Inspector West announces that the hunt for a wanted criminal is over.
When Bergerac investigates a Belgian stablegirl who is living a life of luxury, his enquiries reveal a killer.
Recovering alcoholic Bergerac gets drunk and claims to have seen a murder. Was it real?
When Terri Fuller arrives on Jersey, she is clearly no ordinary tourist - the woman with her has a gun.
The French police believe that Tony Morel killed his wife - Bergerac sets out to prove that he is an innocent victim of circumstance.
When notorious jewel thief Philippa Vale hits town just in time for the private sale of a large diamond, Jim concentrates on maximising security - but it all goes wrong!
With the island's first major boxing match only days away, Bergerac finds that he has to arrest the challenger.
Bergerac has his doubts about the supposed accidents which befall an Arab visitor.
Bergerac investigates the apparently accidental death of Rupert Galliers.
Most successful robberies depend on information. Sadly for Bergerac, so does police work.
A father has a particular reason for choosing Jersey for a holiday.
A private meeting of European financiers attracts some extremely dangerous attention.
Bergerac wonders why he has been given the job of protecting a retired journalist.
Jim Bergerac investigates the death of a scuba diver and a missing wife.
Bergerac investigates when a man appears to have been frightened to death.
Jersey cop Jim becomes involved in a hunt for sunken treasure through an eccentric old lady's mysterious past. Soon he's on the trail of a property tycoon and a gangster.
Jim meets up with the captivating - but as yet uncaptured - jewel thief Philippa Vale, played by Liza Goddard.
Paul and Simone Demoins are too busy preparing for their first Paris fashion show to notice that their daughter's nanny is not all she claims to be. And then they are robbed ...
Rory O'Brien, tennis star, is not Bergerac's favourite personality. Fortunately, liking him is not part of the job. Unfortunately, protecting him is ...
Henry Hoffman might be 'Hollywood's favourite German' but he is nobody else's. Threats to his life come as no surprise to anyone, least of all his fellow actors ...
To the Bureau des Etrangers, Mick Davies is simply a hired killer. But, in politics, especially international politics, nothing is ever simple....
When an elderly millionairess puts her trust in a psychic who claims to speak to the dead, Jim is asked to debunk some supernatural myths.
Mystery surrounds the true identity of John Smythe, who is found wandering around naked.
Jim investigates a death threat against a brilliant millionaire computer engineer.
Jim travels from Jersey to France when a criminal he arrested in the past takes his revenge - by taking Charlie, Debbie and Kim hostage in Brittany.
Susan is endangered by a prospective buyer for a run-down bungalow she is trying to sell.
When a group of animal activists raid a laboratory freeing four monkeys, little do they realise the appalling consequences of their actions.
Philippa asks for Bergerac's help when she is threatened by an extreme right wing organisation over a mystery notebook she knows nothing about.
The mysterious disappearance of a financier leads to complications for Jim.
Jim is drawn into the world of freemasonry when a death occurs during an initiation ceremony.
Murder and a series of apparently unrelated robberies bring Jim Bergerac face to face with his old adversary, Philippa Vale, with unforeseen consequences for them both.
Susan is unhappy when Jim looks after a super grass' smother who is under threat from a gang leader.
Jim's involvement in a dispute between two feuding families causes problems in his attempts to reconcile with Susan.

eps.t: A Horse of a Different Colour
eps.d: The theft of a racehorse and the return of Phillips Vale force Jim to reappraise his relationship with Susan.
Frustrated by Susan's silence, Jim throws himself into his work.
Jim faces a serious moral dilemma when Charlie organises a music festival.
The discovery of a dead body in an empty cottage sparks off a nightmarish case for Jim and his partner, an unorthodox London detective.
Jim finds himself the target of a ruthless criminal when he tries to help Charlie face a skeleton from his past.

Jim is taken from Jersey to spend Christmas on the Costa Del Sol, where two petty British thugs have been trying to get involved in Charlie's latest business venture. When Jim gets involved, he finds himself in the middle of a local gang war while in Jersey, a group of French thieves wreak havoc and Susan's life is in danger.
Bergerac' investigation of a puzzling case involving a dead sailor, toxic waste and a missing girl is not helped by the secondment of a sharp young police officer.
Charlie Hungerford asks Bergerac for help when he receives a series of threatening phone-calls, but is he hiding something from the Detective?
Jim investigates the theft of diamonds from one of the islands' leading socialites.
Jim is disturbed by facts he unearths while investigating the death of Graham Hawkesworth
Jim's plans for a relaxing weekend are turned upside down by a last-minute assignment.

eps.t: When Did You Last See Your Father?
eps.d: Jim finds himself at odds with Crozier when he tries to arrest a man suspected of attacking a young girl on the overnight ferry.
The simultaneous arrivals in Jersey of athlete Peter Jason and Philippa Vale create trouble for Jim.
Jim is curious about a retired Scotland Yard detective who turns up in Jersey.

David Mason murders Ted Grob by throwing him into a swimming pool, handcuffed to a patio bench seat. Jim returns to duty to solve the murder and is asked by an ex-con, who believes he was framed, to go back over the details of the robbery of a courier company some years earlier, which has a connection with the recent death.
Jim is called in when a certain accountant is mysteriously drowned at an international trade fair.
Bergerac investigates a con artist who is being pursued by two criminals.
An archaeological dig starts a frightening chain of events, culminating in the death of a student.
A man refuses to help police find the men making his life unbearable.
A French private detective is murdered in Charlie's study and Bergerac is sent to Provence to discover why.
A business friend of Charlie's sticks her neck out when she harbours a fugitive from South Africa.
Jim Bergerac needs to act quickly when nerve gas is stolen from a research laboratory.
Following a chance meeting at the races, Bergerac is drawn into the world of the cabaret circuit.
Jim ventures out of Jersey to the Big Smoke to help a friend whose daughter has been kidnapped.
Jim is ordered to give up his holiday in France to protect a VIP from assassination.

Jim is now at the vineyard and it is grape-picking time. One of the young casual workers is English boy Roderick. However, he is also a computer hacking genius, able to transfer 90% of the previous day's takings on the Tokyo stock exchange to his own account. The son of the wealthy Hargreaves, he also targets Charlie and other Jersey residents.
Danielle's cousin, a talented designer in Aix-en-Provence, is accused of murder.
Charlie Hungerford persuades Jim to return to Jersey to help find his friend's missing wife.
Jim is involved in a drugs sting in the south of France whilst working as a reluctant babysitter.
An advertisement in the local paper lands Jim a client he would rather not handle.
Charlie gets an offer that is hard to refuse.
An 80th birthday party in France turns out to be more eventful than Jim could possibly have imagined.
Bergerac is employed to probe some companies, but is he in danger?
Bergerac arrives in England to find a runaway wife and finds himself a guest at an Atlantean weekend.
Jim is summoned to a lonely castle in Brittany to meet a mysterious man named Hopgood.
Jim must guard a priceless set of porcelain figures from China.
